notes.title: Ezrebeth, our new full-length visual novel, is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188600/59dbc37ccb8dd49ae522bacc8e04001b33b361d5.png

Rise and shine, Dwellers!

Ezrebeth is finally here!

Experience the most surreal Tymedust Games story yet, offering a time-bending narrative of truly memorable proportions...

“Many twists and turns, with a lot of depth to the characters.”
- Hidden Gem Discovery

“An intriguing and unusual story, gripping with its superb writing and distinctive artwork. Highly recommended.”
- Critiques Sans Frontiers

“An overall display of tragedy, the clash of humane and inhumane, love and inability to love, mundane and the divine, and the great incompatibility of the two options.”
- User Review

We've also put together two bundles at reduced price points if you're looking to complete your collection of games and soundtracks from us: Pitstop in Purgatory + Ezrebeth Duo Pack and Purgatoryverse Complete Pack.

Thank you so much everyone for your support, and we hope you'll enjoy this brand new story of ours!

All the love,
Tymedust Games

notes.title: Poetry in Purgatory DEMO available NOW!
notes.content:
Rise and shine, Dwellers!

We're beyond excited to share that the demo for Poetry in Purgatory is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/f6d8b513fa733f2a3ac8dfb594be540cc8934cbd.png
Weighing in at almost 100 000 words, the demo is quite large and very replayable, offering branching morality choices, two love interests, three optional side stories and much more. You'll be able to get a pretty clear picture of what the full game will bring, along with brand new features such as the PurgaPhone (send and receive messages to/from your friends and foes in Purgatory) and the quest log (no more wondering where to go next).

In addition, the full game will allow you to restore your progress, should you not want to replay everything from the beginning!

We want to make this game as special as it can possibly be, so we'd love to hear your thoughts and impressions over in the community hub if you decide to try out the demo. :)

And as always, wishlisting the game helps us out a ton!

Have yet to take the plunge into the world of Purgatory, or perhaps you're itching to bring a friend into the afterlife at a reduced cost? We've got you covered! 

Pitstop in Purgatory is currently 30% off as part of Steam's 2024 Summer Sale! Don't miss the chance to go buy it if you haven't already.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/2d123c1c25bd884a623ce8e83ca5d3cdcdf8ca34.png
Looking for a short, surreal experience set face-to-face with the one and only The Guide? We know some of you certainly do. Then perhaps you'll enjoy Guidelicious, an absolutely free micro game set in the world of Purgatory. Play it right here, and be sure to collect all the achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780352/df6651fc33ea6d6e482afe513b9a6f8709be84c6.png

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all your support, it truly means the world to us!

Tymedust
